verses.text: In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain;

segments.text: In Jehovah do I take refuge:
How say ye to my soul,

verses.text: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;

segments.text: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow,
They make ready their arrow upon the string,
That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;

verses.text: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?
Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

segments.text: Jehovah is in his holy temple;
Jehovah, his throne is in heaven;
His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

verses.text: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

segments.text: But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

verses.text: Upon the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.

segments.text: Upon the wicked he will rain snares;
Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.text: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.

segments.text: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness:
The upright shall behold his face.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
